tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is the default; Night follows prefers-color-scheme: dark. Also the theme-color meta per theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the Pot hero, list groups.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, the amount keypad, segmented controls, hovered rows. Every text color passes 4.5:1 here in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers between feed items and rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders, unchecked controls. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, balances, the wordmark. 12:1 or better everywhere.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: who and when in the feed, helper copy, 'Your share'. 5.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Marigold, the logo tile. Primary button fill, the goal bar, the 'Add money' and 'Spend' actions. One marigold button per screen. Text on it is always on-brand. Not for text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Goal bar track, selected chip, highlight behind 'Approved by Pot rules'.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button; in Day also the 1px border on marigold buttons (3.5:1 on ground).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on marigold: eggplant, the logo's pot. 8.9:1 on brand.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons like 'View details'. 8.2:1 on Day ground, 11.7:1 on Night ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, every interactive element.

tokens.name: approved
tokens.usage: Approved, money arrived, Pot closed. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Waiting for approvals: '2 of 3 approved', 'Sent to the group'. Blue so it differs from approved in hue and lightness.

tokens.name: declined
tokens.usage: Not approved, failed deposit, refunded. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: member-1
tokens.usage: Member avatar backgrounds, assigned in join order. Initials in on-brand ink (all pass 8:1).

tokens.name: member-2
tokens.usage: Member avatar background 2.

tokens.name: member-3
tokens.usage: Member avatar background 3.

tokens.name: member-4
tokens.usage: Member avatar background 4.

tokens.name: member-5
tokens.usage: Member avatar background 5.

tokens.name: member-6
tokens.usage: Member avatar background 6. Members 7+ reuse the cycle.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference only: the wordmark ships as outlines (pot-wordmark.svg). Gabarito ExtraBold, always lowercase.

styles.name: balance-hero
styles.usage: Pot balance in the hero. Tabular figures. 36px below 360px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Small, expected spending is approved instantly. Anything unusual goes to a quick group vote.
styles.usage: Default text. 16px also on inputs so iOS Safari does not zoom.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Feed meta, helper text, captions. ink-muted.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Amounts in the feed and member list. Tabular figures; incoming prefixed +.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, avatar stack overlap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Feed item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding at 768px+, gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top margin of the invite landing page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, feed cards, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Pot hero card, bottom sheets, dialogs. The logo tile uses the same 22% corner ratio at icon size.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, status pills, the goal bar, segmented controls.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The Pot hero and Pot cards on the home list.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets: Add money, Spend, Approve.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Small phones: balance-hero drops to 36px.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Sheets become centered dialogs; gutter goes to space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Two columns: Pot on the left, Requests and members on the right.

tokens.name: container-flow
tokens.usage: Max width for sheets and flows: Add money, Spend, Approve, join.

tokens.name: container-app
tokens.usage: Max width for the app on desktop.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target. Primary buttons are 52px tall.
